note: This document is the campaign's denominator. The runner reads it to decide what must run and what each report must have observed, and the in-process reconciliation in crates/oxide-batch/tests/m5_upgrade_campaign.rs reads it to decide whether it still says what the accepted documents require.

schema2_runtime.note: The last revision before schema 3 was added. The rejection report builds this revision in a worktree because no build of the current tree can report a supported schema version of 2.

sources.note: Installed by running the immutable migration set to version 1 and stopping, so the fixture is the schema those migrations produced rather than schema 3 wearing an older number.
Installed by running the immutable migration set to version 2 and stopping.

reports.title: Direct upgrade to schema 3
reports.owes: Schema 1 and 2 to schema 3 direct upgrade
reports.name: schema1_and_schema2_upgrade_directly_to_schema3

reports.title: A schema-2 runtime refusing a schema-3 database
reports.name: schema2_runtime_rejects_schema3

paths.expected: one migrator invocation carries a schema-1 database to schema 3, every value of every column schema 1 declared is unchanged, and the result opens through the current repository
one migrator invocation carries a schema-2 database to schema 3, every value of every column schema 2 declared is unchanged, and the result opens through the current repository
the runtime that shipped against schema 2 refuses a database upgraded to schema 3 from both its repository and its migrator, with the typed newer-schema failure, and writes nothing while refusing
the logical backup taken before the upgrade restores into a separate database at schema 1 carrying the state it was taken from, and the current runtime refuses it as needing migration
the logical backup taken before the upgrade restores into a separate database at schema 2 carrying the state it was taken from, and the current runtime refuses it as needing migration

related.name: newer_schema_is_rejected_without_guessing_compatibility
related.note: The lower-level regression test for the comparison the rejection report exercises end to end. It is kept and must keep existing, and this campaign does not run it: it needs a database already migrated to the current schema, which is the crash-and-restore campaign's fixture rather than this one's, and every database this campaign touches it creates itself. It is also not a substitute for the report, because it moves a version number one past whatever this runtime supports, where the report runs a previous runtime against a real schema-3 database.
